extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners or individuals seeking reinstatement to practice before the USPTO (respondents to OED disciplinary actions)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedures and substantive considerations for a petition for reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office under Office of Enrollment and Discipline review. Covers required filings (petition and affidavit) and the Director's basis for deciding whether to grant reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing of a Petition for Reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration has been given to the Petition for Reinstatement of Jingfeng Song (Registration Number 67,105) received on June 8, 2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A petition for reinstatement must be filed and will be considered by the Office of Enrollment and Discipline. The date of receipt is recorded and is relevant to the proceeding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supporting affidavit under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Song also filed an affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 in support of the petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A petition may be supported by an affidavit made in accordance with 37 C.F.R. § 11.58; such an affidavit is considered part of the submission supporting reinstatement and is a contemplated component of the record the Director reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director's review standard — consideration of petition, affidavit, and record material to eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: After careful review of the petition, the supporting affidavit, and all information in the record material to his eligibility for reinstatement, the Director ... has determined that reinstatement ... is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Director evaluates the petition by reviewing: (1) the petition itself, (2) any supporting affidavit(s) submitted under applicable regulation, and (3) all information in the record that is material to the applicant's eligibility. The decision to grant reinstatement is based on whether, in the Director's judgment, reinstatement is appropriate given that combined record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outcome rule — reinstatement granted when Director determines appropriate
rubrics_metrics.description: Accordingly, the petition is hereby GRANTED.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If, after review, the Director determines reinstatement is appropriate, the petition will be granted and the individual is reinstated to practice before the USPTO. The decision is memorialized by the Director's signed order and date.
